create_obfuscation_mode: create an ObfuscationMode instance to process code repositories with obfuscation for dataset generation
extract_obfuscated_data: extract obfuscated code data from a JSON line using a language processor and tokenization
filter_outlier_tokens: filter tokenized data to remove outliers based on variable function and class index thresholds
apply_bpe_to_obfuscated: apply byte pair encoding to obfuscated dataset files and repair BPE for obfuscation special tokens
review_obfuscation_mode_class: review the ObfuscationMode class which extends DatasetMode for code obfuscation and prevents BPE learning on obfuscated data
